title: An irrational sports allegiance
text:
1. 
An irrational sports allegiance

Most men you meet will happily tell you they were one back-pull away from the national team. Maybe a selector's bad mood or politics? The mythology is rich. But really, they weren’t even troubling the reserve bench. But the team you support like they’re blood? That’s different. That’s the emotional hedge you refuse to sell. Every season begins with champagne optimism and ends with a masterclass in humbling character development. Letting eleven other grown men and a coach dictate your mental stability should probably require legal paperwork. You could walk into a sports bar anywhere in the world and find a friend in five minutes flat. Shared suffering is a universal language.
